research_notes: The later shadow-successor lead optimization should include successor bootstrap variance plus predecessor unit-tail plus safety margin.
A validated predecessor hard cap will make residual-budget calculations meaningful.
Without that cap, early READY handoff can waste unknown safe capacity or arrive too late.
Thus the runtime study is prerequisite evidence for the handoff optimization as well as the single-worker policy.
This further supports keeping parallel/handoff research deferred for now.
